# mistershell_sensor_source (Resource)

Manages a MisterShell sensor source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_sensor_source" "example" {
  name    = "corporate-rules"
  url     = "https://rules.example.com/corporate.rules"
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.
- `url` (String) Url.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.
- `parameters` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Parameters. Accepts a native Terraform value.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `id` (String) Object identity. Import using this ID; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `license` (String) License.
- `min_version` (String) Min version.
- `obsolete` (Boolean) Obsolete.
- `params_set` (Boolean) Params set.
- `replaces` (Dynamic) Replaces. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `required_parameters` (Dynamic) Required parameters. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `source_type` (String) Source type.
- `summary` (String) Summary.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.
- `vendor` (String) Vendor.

## Ownership and lifecycle

This resource owns custom sources. Backend index sources are available through the data source and cannot be imported as managed resources.

Parameter updates merge secrets on the server. Removing keys, or supplying blank, null or masked values, cannot clear stored secrets and is rejected. To clear parameters, explicitly replace the custom source. Destroy deletes the custom source and its stored parameters.

## Import

```shell
terraform import mistershell_sensor_source.example 123
```
